interface.name: waydock_blur_manager_v1

description.summary: optional blur radius policy for desktop clients

interface.description: This extension selects a per-surface blur radius for the standard ext-background-effect-v1 protocol. It does not enable blur or define a blur region by itself. The standard manager's blur capability still determines whether the compositor can apply background blur.

entry.name: surface_exists
entry.summary: surface already has a blur radius object

interface.name: waydock_blur_surface_v1

description.summary: double-buffered blur radius for a surface

interface.description: The initial radius is 10 logical surface pixels. State takes effect on wl_surface.commit, including synchronization of subsurfaces. This object may be created before or after the standard background effect object. Without a non-empty standard blur region it has no visual effect.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: restore the default radius on the next commit

request.description: This request restores radius 10 on the next wl_surface.commit. It does not change the standard background effect object's region.

entry.name: surface_destroyed
entry.summary: the associated surface has been destroyed

request.name: set_radius

description.summary: set pending radius in logical pixels

request.description: Valid values are 0 through 40, inclusive. Zero suppresses blur without changing the standard background effect region. The region and radius are applied together at the next surface commit. Requests after the associated surface has been destroyed raise surface_destroyed.
